_comment: Maps an OpenGraph edge KIND -> an `ocinferno` module command that traverses that edge. A post-pass (edge_command_annotator.annotate_edge_module_commands) runs at export time, fills the {placeholders} from the edge's own endpoint NODE data, and writes the resolved string into the edge's `example_command` property (+ any `includes_edges` into `includes_other_edges`). Add an entry here to give any edge a runnable example -- no builder changes needed. Placeholders resolved from the edge + its destination node: {source_id} {destination_id} {dest_ocid} {dest_domain_url} {dest_compartment} {dest_name}. A placeholder with no value in the graph is left as an <UPPERCASE> hint.

OCI_CREATE_USER_API_KEY.template: modules run exploit_add_user_api_key --user-ocid <TARGET_USER_OCID>  # any user in {dest_compartment}; omit flags for interactive user selection

IDD_IDENTITY_ADMIN_USER.authz: Identity Domain app-role: Identity Domain Administrator

OCI_CREATE_USER.template: modules run exploit_create_user --name <NEW_USERNAME> --with-api-key  # new user in {dest_compartment}

OCI_CREATE_POLICY.template: modules run exploit_write_policy --self  # or --any-user / --group NAME ; grant scoped to {dest_compartment}

OCI_UPDATE_POLICY.template: modules run exploit_write_policy --append-to {destination_id} --self  # append an admin grant to an existing policy

GENERATE_RPST.authz: OCI IAM manage permissions on the target resource type (fn-function, devops-build-pipeline, dataflow-runs, compute-container-instances, data-science-job-runs, etc.)
GENERATE_RPST.template: modules run exploit_generate_rpst_fn --resource-ocid {dest_ocid}  # inject RPST exfil into {dest_name}; see wiki RPST-Extraction for per-service procedure
